documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Grant Of Patent

analysis.summary: Acutaas Chemicals reported strong Q1 FY27 financial results with revenue reaching INR329.7 crores, representing a 59.1% growth year-on-year. Management remains confident in achieving a 25% full-year revenue growth target with stable margins, supported by robust demand in Advanced Pharmaceutical Intermediates and the successful commercialization of its battery chemicals plant. Furthermore, the company is progressing well with its semiconductor chemicals capacity at Indichem and is systematically phasing out commodity chemicals to focus on higher-margin products. Acutaas Chemicals Limited reported a strong start to FY27, with Q1 revenue from operations growing 59.1% year-on-year to Rs. 3,297 million, EBITDA increasing 122.1% to Rs.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of delivering 25% revenue growth for the full year with stable margins.
guidance.quote: To conclude, we have started the new financial year on a strong note and I remain confident of delivering 25% revenue growth for the full year with stable margins.

guidance.claim: The company expects a similar level of EBITDA margin for the full year FY27 compared to the full year FY26.
guidance.quote: For current financial year, for the full year, as we guided during the commentary also, we are expecting a similar kind of margin as we had for full year FY '26.

guidance.claim: Management projects good growth in the new age specialty chemical business.
guidance.quote: Overall, we are projecting good growth in the new age specialty chemical business.

guidance.claim: Management is confident of delivering 25% revenue growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: I'm confident of delivering 25% revenue growth in FY '27.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margin to remain at a similar level in the coming year.
guidance.quote: We are confident in our ability to maintain EBITDA margin at a similar level in the coming year.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment for the company's products remains strong as reflected in the quarterly results.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment for our products remains strong as reflected in the quarter's results.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for battery chemicals remains exceptionally strong.
demand_outlook.quote: Within Specialty Chemicals, demand for battery chemicals remain exceptionally strong.

demand_outlook.claim: Engagement with customers reinforces conviction that memory chip demand will remain strong.
demand_outlook.quote: Our ongoing engagement with customers reinforces our conviction that memory chip demand will remain strong.

demand_outlook.claim: The core Pharmaceutical Intermediates business delivered robust growth driven by top products and new products gaining volume traction.
demand_outlook.quote: While CDMO grew strongly year-on-year as we expected, the core Pharmaceutical Intermediates business also delivered a robust growth. This was driven by our top products as well as by a couple of new products that are gaining volume traction.

demand_outlook.claim: On the demand side, momentum remains strong with new product inquiries coming in at a healthy pace.
demand_outlook.quote: On the demand side, momentum remains strong. New product inquiries continue to come in at a healthy pace while demand for existing products remain robust.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for Q1 FY27 stood at INR56 crores, including INR15 crores at the Indichem site and INR41 crores primarily at the ACL site for the battery chemical project at Jhagadia, a pilot plant at Sachin, and maintenance capex.
capex_expansion.quote: Now turning to the capital expenditures. capex for Q1 FY '27 stood at INR56 crores, out of which INR15 crores were at the Indichem site, remaining INR41 crores in ACL site, which is primarily diverted towards the battery chemical project at the Jhaghadia site. And then pilot plant at our Sachin site and maintenance capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The Indichem plant capex is expected to get completed by the end of the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: So this plant, we are happy to share that this is getting constructed even before the schedules and expected to get -- capex is expected to get completed by end of this quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: The company will incur additional capex for a new R&D center and land acquisition for further capacity expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: As mentioned on our previous earnings call, we will incur additional capex for a new R&D center and for the acquisition of land for further capacity expansion, we will update the market once these projects are finalized.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for FY26 stood at INR195 crores primarily directed towards the Jhagadia site for battery chemical project, pilot plant at Sachin site, and maintenance capex.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex for FY '26 stood at INR195 crores primarily directed towards the Jhagadia site for battery chemical project and then pilot plant at Sachin site and maintenance capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The first phase of electrolyte capex at Jhagadia is completed and the second phase is expected to be completed by Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Regarding the electrolyte additive capex at Jhagadia, the first phase of electrolyte capex is completed. The second phase of capex is currently ongoing and expected to get completed by Q1 FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Pilot plant capex is now expected to get completed by Q2 FY27 due to a slight delay in equipment arrival.
capex_expansion.quote: Pilot plant capex is slightly delayed due to delay in equipment arrival. It is now expected to get completed by Q2 FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested INR190 crores in its South Korea joint venture, Indichem Inc., during FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: Apart from this, another major cash outlay during the year was our investment in South Korea joint venture, Indichem Inc. We have invested INR190 crores in this JV during the year FY '26.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for the quarter was INR190.9 crores, representing a 73% increase compared to the same period last year.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit for the quarter was INR190.9 crores, reflecting a 73% increase compared to the same period last year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by 466 basis points year-on-year to 57.9%, driven by higher contribution from the Pharma Intermediate business.
margins_costs.quote: The gross margin expanded by 466 basis points Y-o-Y to 57.9%. Gross margin was driven by higher contribution from Pharma Intermediate business compared to same period last year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR113.1 crores, representing more than a twofold increase compared to the same period last year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR113.1 crores, which represents more than twofold increase compared to the EBITDA of the same period last year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stood at 34.3%, up 973 basis points year-on-year, driven by gross margin expansion and operational efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin were at 34.3%, up 973 basis points Y-o-Y. EBITDA margin was driven by expansion in gross margin as well as operational efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for the quarter was INR74.9 crores, up 70.4% year-on-year, with PAT margins at 22.7%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT for the quarter was INR74.9 crores, up 70.4% Y-o-Y. PAT margins for the quarter were at 22.7%, which show an expansion of 151 basis points Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: The Specialty Chemicals business operates at around 24% margin while the Pharma business operates at around 36% margin.
margins_costs.quote: So with regard to margin, our Spec Chem business is having around 24% margin and Pharma business is having around 36% margin.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin for the quarter expanded by 1,467 basis points year-on-year to 62% driven by improved product mix.
margins_costs.quote: The gross margin expanded by 1,467 basis points Y-o-Y to 62%. Gross margin was driven by improved product mix.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins for the quarter were 31%, showing an expansion of 1,070 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margins for the quarter were 31%, which show an expansion of 1,070 basis points Y-o-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for the Sachin unit is 83%, Unit 2 at Ankleshwar is 23%, and Unit 3 Jhagadia is 55% for the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Okay. For the capacity utilization for the Sachin unit, the capacity is 83%. For Unit 2 at Ankleshwar, it is 23% and at Unit 3 Jhagadia, 55% for the quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The battery chemicals plant has a capacity of 2,000 metric tons for VC and 2,000 metric tons for FEC.
orders_capacity.quote: So you know that the plant, we have a capacity of 2,000 metric tons for VC and 2,000 metric tons for FEC.

orders_capacity.claim: The capacity for electrolyte additive is 2,000 metric ton for VC and FEC.
orders_capacity.quote: And as of now, the capacity for electrolyte additive is 2,000 metric ton for VC and FEC.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash and cash equivalents were around INR314 crores as on 30th June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash and cash equivalents were around INR314 crores as on 30th June 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital for the quarter stands at 99 days versus 91 days in Q4 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Our working capital for the quarter stands at 99 days versus 91 days in Q4 FY '26.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash and cash equivalents were at INR198.3 crores as on 31st March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash and cash equivalents were at INR198.3 crores as on 31st March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital for the year increased to 120 days from 114 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Our working capital for the year increased to 120 days from 114 days.

risks_headwinds.claim: The financial year began on a turbulent note, driven by geopolitical tensions in the Gulf.
risks_headwinds.quote: We began the financial year on a turbulent note, driven by geopolitical tensions in the Gulf.

risks_headwinds.claim: The chemical industry is navigating turbulent conditions driven by the ongoing conflict in the Gulf region.
risks_headwinds.quote: The chemical industry has once again navigating turbulent conditions driven by the ongoing conflict in the Gulf region, which has disrupted supply chain for key feedstocks and consequently pushed raw material prices higher.

management_commitments.claim: Revenue from the Indichem plant is expected to commence from next financial year onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And maybe from next financial year onwards, we will have the revenue coming up from that plant.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 2 capex for the electrolyte additives segment will be completed by the end of Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And as we mentioned earlier also by end of Q2 FY '27, we would be completing our capex.

management_commitments.claim: Revenue from four validated CDMO products is expected to kick in from H2 FY27 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And with regulatory approval in place, we are expecting revenue to kick in from H2 FY '27 onwards.

management_commitments.claim: By FY28, both business verticals in the investment phase (battery chemicals and semiconductors) will have evolved into independent self-sustaining growth engines.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, I believe that by FY '28, our both business verticals, which are in investment phase now, battery chemicals and semiconductors will evolved into independent self-sustaining growth engines.

management_commitments.claim: The second phase of electrolyte capex is currently ongoing and expected to get completed by Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The second phase of capex is currently ongoing and expected to get completed by Q1 FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The pilot plant capex is now expected to get completed by Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: It is now expected to get completed by Q2 FY '27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
